name: add_template_conditional_blocks
description: Add {{#if key}}...{{/if}} conditional blocks (with nesting) to a plain {{key}} template renderer; broken uses a single non-recursive global replace that mishandles nested blocks
prompts: template.js's render(template, data) only substitutes {{key}} placeholders. Add {{#if key}}...{{/if}} conditional blocks: the content between the tags is kept only when data[key] is truthy (otherwise the whole block, tags included, is removed), plain {{key}} substitution still happens on whatever survives, and - this is the hard part - IF-BLOCKS MUST NEST correctly: {{#if outer}}A{{#if inner}}B{{/if}}C{{/if}}D must resolve the inner block first and the outer block second (a single regex.replace with the global flag resolves left-to-right and mishandles this - you likely need to resolve one innermost match at a time, or parse recursively). Keep the function name, signature, and module.exports.
